scope: Frozen causal one-step current restoration on synthetic wrist-only bursts. Observed-history control and selected closed-loop corrected-history rollouts. No images, no future observations as inputs, no test labels, no optimizer. Not real drift accuracy or a proof of why training failed.

threshold_sensitivity.initial_attempt_error: Dummy batch omitted forecast_dt; KeyError before any threshold output. Added positive forecast query times and reran; no production training change.
threshold_sensitivity.scope: Same random draw schedule and profile on dummy identity references. Amplitudes do not depend on source poses; matched case and 6mm count histograms to original real-reference sampler audit. Threshold sensitivity, not replay of production inputs.
